raw-colors.defect: Hand-picked unrelated colors instead of scheme roles: orange header, teal buttons, purple section titles, yellow and pink selections, and a non-error red on account details and the avatar.

no-dark.defect: No dark styles at all: the dark screenshot is identical to the light one.

wrong-components.defect: Checkboxes for instant on/off settings, plain bordered divs as buttons, and a tab strip as top-level navigation instead of a navigation bar or rail.

cramped.defect: Cramped, uneven, off-grid spacing (2-19px gaps, 3-9px paddings), misaligned list icons and text, and a clipped 'Export transactions' label.

no-states.defect: No selected, focus or disabled styling, unlabeled text fields without helper text, and a validation error shown only by a red border.

generic-look.defect: Generic default look: browser-default buttons, inputs and select, system blue links, leftover placeholder copy, and icons in mixed styles.

flat-type.defect: Every text uses the same size and weight; the page title and section titles read like body text.

random-shapes.defect: Random corner radii: a pill card beside a sharp card, a 3px button beside a 28px button, and switches, fields and indicators with mismatched corners.
